# Setup

```{r Libraries}

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(mapview) # for interactive maps
library(RColorBrewer)
library(colorspace) # color palettes, check them out with hcl_palettes(plot = TRUE) or divergingx_palettes(plot = TRUE)
library(viridis)
library(treemapify)
library(ggmap)
library(reshape2)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggbreak) # to add scale brakes in plots
library(ggrepel) # for repulsive textual annotations


# add family colors for plots
fam_cols <- readRDS("family_palette_14_spectral_alpha.rds")

# Custom ggplot theme
theme_karl <- theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent"), # bg of the panel
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA), # bg of the plot
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # get rid of major grid
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # get rid of minor grid
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent"), # get rid of legend bg
    legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA), # get rid of legend panel bg
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA), # get rid of key legend fill
    legend.title= element_blank(), # remove the legend title
    legend.text=element_text(size=10), # increase the text of legend
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "gray15", linewidth = 1), # adding a wider gray line for x and y axis
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "gray15", linewidth = 1), # change the ticks to same color as line
    axis.title.x = element_text(face="bold"), # make the x axis title bold
    axis.title.y = element_text(face="bold"), # make the y axis title bold
    strip.background = element_rect(fill="gray95"), # change color of strips
    strip.text =  element_text(face="bold", size = 12), # increase the font size of group titles
    axis.ticks.length=unit(.25, "cm"), # increase the length of the axis ticks
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"), # make the numbers on x-axis bold
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"), # make the numbers on y-axis bold
    axis.title = element_text(size=14), # Increase the axis label size
    axis.text = element_text(size=12) # Increase tick text size
)

theme_honey <- theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent"), # bg of the panel
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA), # bg of the plot
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey80", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.5), # add dotted major grid
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "grey90", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.2), # add dotted minor grid
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent"), # get rid of legend bg
    legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA), # get rid of legend panel bg
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA), # get rid of key legend fill
    legend.title= element_blank(), # remove the legend title
    legend.text=element_text(size=10), # increase the text of legend
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "gray15", linewidth = 1), # adding a wider gray line for x and y axis
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "gray15", linewidth = 1), # change the ticks to same color as line
    axis.title.x = element_text(face="bold"), # make the x axis title bold
    axis.title.y = element_text(face="bold"), # make the y axis title bold
    strip.background = element_rect(fill="gray95"), # change color of strips
    strip.text = element_text(face="bold", size = 12), # increase the font size of group titles
    axis.ticks.length=unit(.25, "cm"), # increase the length of the axis ticks
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"), # make the numbers on x-axis bold
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"), # make the numbers on y-axis bold
    axis.title = element_text(size=14), # Increase the axis label size
    axis.text = element_text(size=12) # Increase tick text size
)


```

# Data import and preparation

```{r Data}

df.species <- read.delim(file="DATA/Species_blast.tsv") # use the blast results instead of Species.tsv
df.GPS <- read.table(file = "DATA/Beekeepers.tsv", sep = "\t", header = TRUE) 
df.batch <- read.table(file = "DATA/Batch.tsv", sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
df.seq <- read.table("DATA/Sequence_table.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")

# merge to joint df
df <- full_join(df.species, df.batch, by="Strain.ID") %>% 
  full_join(., df.GPS, by="Batch.ID") %>% 
  full_join(., df.seq, by="Strain.ID") %>% # include if sequences are desired
  arrange(Strain.ID)

# Export table
# write.table(df, "strain_info.tsv", quote = F, row.names = F, sep = "\t")

```

# Geographic distribution of honey yeast isolates
### Fig 1D Sampling locations and categories

```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(ggspatial)
library(lwgeom)

# Prepare your data and count isolates by Batch.ID
df.temp <- read.delim("DATA/Hive_sites_analysis.tsv", sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Add jitter to avoid overlapping points
df.temp$lat <- jitter(df.temp$Latitude, factor = 1)
df.temp$lon <- jitter(df.temp$Longitude, factor = 1)

# Load all countries in Europe at a medium scale
countries <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# Filter out Sweden for special coloring
sweden <- countries %>% filter(name == "Sweden")

# Filter out all other countries except Sweden
other_countries <- countries %>% filter(name != "Sweden")

# Load lakes data and ensure valid geometries
lakes <- ne_download(scale = "medium", type = "lakes", category = "physical", returnclass = "sf")
lakes <- st_make_valid(lakes)
lakes_sweden <- st_intersection(lakes, sweden)

# Convert your data to an sf object
df.temp_sf <- st_as_sf(df.temp, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = other_countries, fill = "gray99", color = "gray87") +
  geom_sf(data = sweden, fill = "white", color = "black") +
  geom_sf(data = lakes_sweden, fill = "lightblue", color = NA) +
  geom_sf(
    data = df.temp_sf,
    aes(fill = analysis_environment_class),
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.7,
    shape = 21,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(5, 31), ylim = c(55, 71)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      urban_suburban = hcl.colors(14, palette = "Spectral")[2],
      agriculture_dominated = hcl.colors(14, palette = "Spectral")[6],
      rural_mixed = hcl.colors(14, palette = "Spectral")[10]
    ),
    labels = c(
      urban_suburban = "Urban/suburban",
      agriculture_dominated = "Agriculture-dominated",
      rural_mixed = "Rural mixed"
    )
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "left")

ggsave(
  "PLOTS/Fig1D_hive_sites.pdf",
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  units = "in"
)

#### Fig 1D donut chart insert

df.env <- read.delim("DATA/Hive_sites_analysis.tsv", sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

env_colors <- c(
  urban_suburban = hcl.colors(14, palette = "Spectral")[2],
  agriculture_dominated = hcl.colors(14, palette = "Spectral")[6],
  rural_mixed = hcl.colors(14, palette = "Spectral")[10]
)

env_labels <- c(
  urban_suburban = "Urban/suburban",
  agriculture_dominated = "Agriculture-dominated",
  rural_mixed = "Rural mixed"
)

df.donut <- df.env %>%
  count(analysis_environment_class) %>%
  mutate(
    analysis_environment_class = factor(
      analysis_environment_class,
      levels = c("urban_suburban", "agriculture_dominated", "rural_mixed")
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(analysis_environment_class)

legend_labels <- setNames(
  paste0(
    env_labels[as.character(df.donut$analysis_environment_class)],
    " (n = ",
    df.donut$n,
    ")"
  ),
  as.character(df.donut$analysis_environment_class)
)

ggplot(df.donut, aes(x = 2, y = n, fill = analysis_environment_class)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  xlim(0.5, 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = env_colors,
    labels = legend_labels
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

ggsave(
  "PLOTS/Fig1D_hive_donut.pdf",
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  units = "in"
)

```

### Fig 4A strain subset on a pie map

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(lwgeom)
library(scatterpie)

df.temp <- df %>%
  filter(Strain.ID %in% strain.subset) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Species), !Species %in% c("No significant", "")) %>%
  tidyr::extract(Species, into = c("Family", "name"), regex = "^(\\S+)\\s+(.+)$", remove = FALSE) %>%
  select(
    Strain.ID, Batch.ID, Beekeeper.ID, Sample.type,
    Latitude, Longitude, Extraction.date, Species, Family
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Latitude), !is.na(Longitude), !is.na(Family))

site_family <- df.temp %>%
  group_by(Latitude, Longitude, Family) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

pie_df <- site_family %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Family,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )

family_cols <- setdiff(names(pie_df), c("Latitude", "Longitude"))

pie_df <- pie_df %>%
  mutate(total_n = rowSums(across(all_of(family_cols))))

missing_cols <- setdiff(family_cols, names(fam_cols))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  fam_cols <- c(fam_cols, setNames(rep("steelblue4", length(missing_cols)), missing_cols))
}

sites_sf <- st_as_sf(
  pie_df,
  coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"),
  crs = 4326
) %>%
  st_transform(3006)

coords <- st_coordinates(sites_sf)
pie_df$x <- coords[, 1]
pie_df$y <- coords[, 2]

pie_df$radius <- sqrt(pie_df$total_n) * 11000

countries <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf") %>%
  st_transform(3006)

sweden <- countries %>% filter(name == "Sweden")

lakes_sweden <- tryCatch({
  ne_download(
    scale = "medium",
    type = "lakes",
    category = "physical",
    returnclass = "sf"
  ) %>%
    st_make_valid() %>%
    st_transform(3006) %>%
    st_intersection(sweden)
}, error = function(e) {
  NULL
})

family_cols <- intersect(family_cols, names(fam_cols))

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = sweden, fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

if (!is.null(lakes_sweden)) {
  p <- p + geom_sf(data = lakes_sweden, fill = "lightblue", color = NA)
}

p <- p +
  geom_scatterpie(
    data = pie_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y, r = radius),
    cols = family_cols,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.1,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    crs = st_crs(3006),
    xlim = c(250000, 930000),
    ylim = c(6100000, 7690000),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fam_cols[family_cols], drop = FALSE, na.value = "steelblue4")

print(p)

ggsave(
  "PLOTS/Fig4A_map_strain_subset.pdf",
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  units = "in"
)

```

### Fig 3A map isolates per county

```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(ggspatial)
library(lwgeom)
library(colorspace)
library(scales)

# ---- POINT DATA PREPARATION ----
df.temp <- df %>% 
  filter(!Species %in% c(NA, "No significant", "")) %>%
  select(Batch.ID, Beekeeper.ID, Sample.type, Latitude, Longitude, 
         Bee.strain, Extraction.date, Species, Strain.ID) %>%
  group_by(Beekeeper.ID, Latitude, Longitude) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

# Add jitter to avoid overlapping points
df.temp$lat <- jitter(df.temp$Latitude, factor = 1)
df.temp$lon <- jitter(df.temp$Longitude, factor = 1)

# Convert to sf
df.temp_sf <- st_as_sf(df.temp, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

# ---- LANDSCAPE & COUNTY DATA PREPARATION ----
countries <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
sweden <- countries %>% filter(name == "Sweden")
other_countries <- countries %>% filter(name != "Sweden")

sweden_counties <- ne_states(country = "Sweden", returnclass = "sf")

# Spatial join: points to county
df.temp_for_counties <- df %>%
  select(Beekeeper.ID, Latitude, Longitude, Species, Strain.ID)

df.temp_sf_county <- st_as_sf(df.temp_for_counties, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)
df.temp_sf_with_county <- st_join(df.temp_sf_county, sweden_counties)

# Count isolates per county
county_isolate_data <- df.temp_sf_with_county %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

sweden_counties_with_data <- left_join(sweden_counties, st_drop_geometry(county_isolate_data), by = "name")
sweden_counties_with_data$count[is.na(sweden_counties_with_data$count)] <- NA  # unsampled = NA

# Lakes
lakes <- ne_download(scale = "medium", type = "lakes", category = "physical", returnclass = "sf")
lakes <- st_make_valid(lakes)
lakes_sweden <- st_intersection(lakes, sweden)

# ---- PLOT ----
ggplot() +
  # geom_sf(data = other_countries, fill = "gray96", color = "gray80") +
  geom_sf(data = sweden_counties_with_data, aes(fill = count), color = "black", size = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = lakes_sweden, fill = "lightblue", color = NA) +
  # geom_sf(data = df.temp_sf, aes(size = count, color = count), alpha = 0.6, shape = 20) +
      geom_sf(data = df.temp_sf, aes(size = count, fill = count), 
        color = "gray30", shape = 21, alpha = 0.7, fill = "yellow3") +
  scale_fill_continuous_sequential(
    palette = "YlOrBr",
    name = "Isolates per County",
    na.value = "gray96",
    oob = squish
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "Strains (n)",
    range = c(1, 10),
    breaks = c(1, 10, 50, 100, 500)
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(5, 27), ylim = c(55, 70)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.1, 0.9),
    legend.justification = c(0, 1),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )


ggsave(
  "PLOTS/Fig3A_abundance_at_sites_map.pdf",
  width = 7,
  height = 9,
  units = "in"
)

```

# Taxonomic diversity of honey yeasts

### Fig 3B Most common genera on separate maps

```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(lwgeom)
library(purrr)

# Secect data
families_keep <- c("Starmerella", "Zygosaccharomyces", "Rhodotorula",
                   "Aureobasidium", "Metschnikowia", "Entelexis")

df.temp <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(Species), !Species %in% c("No significant", "")) %>%
  separate(Species, into = c("Family", "name"),
           sep = "^\\S*\\K\\s+", remove = FALSE) %>%
  filter(Family %in% families_keep) %>%
  select(Batch.ID, Beekeeper.ID, Sample.type, Latitude, Longitude,
         Bee.strain, Extraction.date, Species, Family) %>%
  group_by(Beekeeper.ID, Family, Latitude, Longitude) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Jitter to reduce overlap (degrees; tweak if needed)
set.seed(1)
df.temp <- df.temp %>%
  mutate(
    lat = jitter(Latitude,  amount = 0.04),
    lon = jitter(Longitude, amount = 0.06)
  )

df.temp_sf <- st_as_sf(df.temp, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

# Define the basic map structure
countries <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
sweden <- countries %>% filter(name == "Sweden")

lakes <- ne_download(scale = "medium", type = "lakes",
                     category = "physical", returnclass = "sf") %>%
  st_make_valid()

lakes_sweden <- st_intersection(lakes, sweden)

# Select colors
family_cols <- c(
  Starmerella        = "#69D6AF",
  Entelexis          ="#F1921D",
  Zygosaccharomyces  = "#1A78B0",
  Rhodotorula        = "#ADEAAD",
  Aureobasidium      = "#A71B4B",
  Metschnikowia      = "#FCD87C"
)


# Plot function (one family at a time)
plot_family_map <- function(fam) {
  dat_fam <- df.temp_sf %>% filter(Family == fam)

  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = sweden, fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_sf(data = lakes_sweden, fill = "lightblue", color = NA) +
    geom_sf(
      data = dat_fam,
      aes(size = count),
      color = family_cols[[fam]],
      alpha = 0.6,
      shape = 20
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      trans = "sqrt",
      range = c(2, 12),
      limits = c(1, 238),         # <- global scaling across all family maps
      breaks = c(1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 64, 238),
      name = "isolates (n)"
    ) +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(5, 27), ylim = c(55, 70), expand = FALSE) +
    theme_void() +
    ggtitle(fam) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "italic"),
      legend.position = c(0.1, 0.9),
      legend.justification = c(0, 1)
    )
}


# Generate all six maps
plots <- set_names(families_keep) %>% map(plot_family_map)

# View one:
# plots$Metschnikowia

# Save all
walk2(
  plots,
  names(plots),
  ~ ggsave(
      filename = file.path("PLOTS", paste0("Fig3B_map_", .y, ".pdf")),
      plot = .x,
      width = 4,
      height = 6
    )
)

```

### Figure 2B Treemap of genera

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(treemapify)

df_treemap <- df.species %>%
  filter(!Species %in% c(NA, "No significant")) %>%
  separate(Species, into = c("Family", "name"), sep = "^\\S*\\K\\s+", remove = FALSE) %>%
  count(Family, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    # 1) Define "sections" (edit the cutoffs to taste)
    Section = case_when(
      n >= 200 ~ "Most common",
      n >= 50  ~ "Common",
      n >= 5  ~ "Less common",
      TRUE     ~ "Rare"
    )
  )

ggplot(df_treemap, aes(
  area = n,
  fill = n,
  label = Family,
  subgroup = Section     # 1) this is what creates “sections”
)) +
  geom_treemap(color = "black", size = 1.5) +

  # 1) Draw section borders and label each section
  geom_treemap_subgroup_border(color = "white", size = 2) +
  geom_treemap_subgroup_text(
    place = "topleft",
    grow = TRUE,
    alpha = 0.9,
    colour = "black",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  # Family labels (center)
  geom_treemap_text(
    colour = "black",
    fontface = "bold.italic",
    place = "middle",
    reflow = TRUE,
    min.size = 0.1
  ) +

  # 2) Counts in bottom-right, with size mapped to n (smaller for small groups)
  geom_treemap_text(
    aes(label = n, size = n),
    colour = "gray20",
    fontface = "plain",
    place = "bottomright",
    reflow = FALSE,
    grow = FALSE
  ) +
 scale_size(range = c(3, 14), trans = "log2", guide = "none") +

  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = rev(hcl.colors(100, "Heat")),
    trans = "log2",
    name = "Number of isolates"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm")
  )

ggsave(filename = "PLOTS/Fig2B_Treemap.pdf")

```

### Fig 3A Family vs latitude bar plot

This plot is a bit tricky to get right directly from R, adjust in Illustrator.

```{r}

# calculate family counts to determine the group sizes
family_counts <- df %>%
  filter(!Species %in% c(NA,"No significant", "")) %>% # remove unknown
  separate(Species, into = c("Family", "name"), sep = "^\\S*\\K\\s+", remove = FALSE) %>%  # get family names
  count(Family)

# plot as a ratio
df %>% 
  filter(!Species %in% c(NA, "No significant", "")) %>%  # remove unknown species
  separate(Species, into = c("Family", "name"), sep = "^\\S*\\K\\s+", remove = FALSE) %>%  # get family names
  left_join(family_counts, by = "Family") %>%
  mutate(Family = if_else(n < 10, NA, Family)) %>%  # Yeast families that are isolated less than 10 times are unnamed here
  group_by(Family, Latitude) %>% 
  count() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(fill = Family, 
             x = as.character(Latitude),
             y = n,
             label = Family)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = hcl.colors(14, palette = "spectral", rev = FALSE),  # Use HCL colors for a nicer palette
    na.value = "steelblue4",  # Color the unnamed groups as black
    name = "Number of isolates"  # Name of the legend
  ) +
  labs(x = "", y = "") +  # Adjust axis labels
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +  # Remove padding around the bars
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +  # Minimal expansion for y to avoid clipping the top
  theme_karl +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 4),
    legend.key.width = unit(2, 'cm')
  )

ggsave("PLOTS/Fig3A_Latitude_diversity_genera.pdf", width = 7, height = 10)

# plot the counts on top
df %>% 
  filter(!Species %in% c(NA, "No significant", "")) %>%  # remove unknown species
  separate(Species, into = c("Family", "name"), sep = "^\\S*\\K\\s+", remove = FALSE) %>%  # get family names
  group_by(Latitude) %>% 
  count() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(fill = n, 
             x = as.character(Latitude),
             y = n)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity") +
  scale_y_break(c(50, 150), space = 1, ticklabels = c(160)) +  # Custom y-axis breaks
  scale_y_break(c(170, 500), space = 1, ticklabels = c(502)) +  # Custom y-axis breaks
  scale_fill_viridis(
    discrete = FALSE,
    option = "C",
    limits = c(0, 80),  # Limit the scale to avoid the large group from taking all focus
    direction = -1,
    na.value = "firebrick3",  # Color the large group outside of limit
    name = "Number of isolates"  # Name of the legend
  ) +
  labs(x = "", y = "") +  # Remove axis labels
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +  # Remove padding around the x-axis
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0.05)) +  # Minimal expansion for y-axis
  theme_karl +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.key.width = unit(2, 'cm'),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),  # Remove x-axis text (numbers)
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),  # Remove x-axis tick marks
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black"),  # Add x-axis line
    panel.grid = element_blank(),  # Remove gridlines for clarity
    panel.border = element_blank()  # Remove the panel border for a cleaner look
  )

# export as a short plot
ggsave("Plots/Fig3A_Latitude_diversity_count.pdf", width = 7, height = 10)
```

### Fig 3C Jaccard similarity on species
```{r}

# Load packages
library(dplyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(vegan)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

# df is assumed to already be loaded in R

temp2 <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(Species), !Species %in% c("No significant", "")) %>%
  select(Strain.ID, Species, Batch.ID, Sample.type, Latitude, Longitude, Extraction.date)

if (is.numeric(temp2$Extraction.date)) {
  temp2$Extraction.date <- as.character(temp2$Extraction.date)
}
temp2$Extraction.date <- as.Date(temp2$Extraction.date, format = "%Y%m%d")
temp2$Month <- format(temp2$Extraction.date, "%m")

batch_meta <- temp2 %>%
  distinct(Batch.ID, Sample.type, Latitude, Longitude, Month)

isolate_counts <- temp2 %>%
  count(Batch.ID, name = "Isolates")

batch_meta <- batch_meta %>%
  left_join(isolate_counts, by = "Batch.ID")

presence_counts <- xtabs(~ Batch.ID + Species, data = temp2)
presence_binary <- (presence_counts > 0) * 1

batch_meta <- batch_meta[match(rownames(presence_binary), batch_meta$Batch.ID), ]
stopifnot(identical(as.character(batch_meta$Batch.ID), rownames(presence_binary)))

jaccard_dist <- vegdist(presence_binary, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)
jaccard_similarity <- 1 - as.matrix(jaccard_dist)

batch_hclust <- hclust(as.dist(1 - jaccard_similarity), method = "average")

latitude_breaks <- seq(min(batch_meta$Latitude), max(batch_meta$Latitude), length.out = 5)
latitude_colors <- colorRamp2(latitude_breaks, hcl.colors(5, "YlGnBu"))

sample_types <- unique(batch_meta$Sample.type)
sample_type_colors <- setNames(
  hcl.colors(length(sample_types), "YlOrRd", rev = TRUE),
  sample_types
)

present_months <- sort(unique(batch_meta$Month))
month_labels <- setNames(month.abb, sprintf("%02d", 1:12))
present_month_labels <- unname(month_labels[present_months])
month_colors <- setNames(
  hcl.colors(length(present_months), "Hawaii"),
  present_month_labels
)

isolate_breaks <- seq(min(batch_meta$Isolates), max(batch_meta$Isolates), length.out = 5)
isolate_colors <- colorRamp2(isolate_breaks, hcl.colors(5, "Sunset"))

annotation_colors <- list(
  Month = month_colors,
  SampleType = sample_type_colors,
  Latitude = latitude_colors,
  Isolates = isolate_colors
)

bottom_annotation <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Month = factor(batch_meta$Month, levels = present_months, labels = present_month_labels),
  SampleType = batch_meta$Sample.type,
  Latitude = batch_meta$Latitude,
  Isolates = batch_meta$Isolates,
  col = annotation_colors,
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9)
)

heatmap_colors <- colorRamp2(
  c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
  hcl.colors(5, "Lajolla")
)

ht <- Heatmap(
  jaccard_similarity,
  name = "Jaccard similarity",
  col = heatmap_colors,
  cluster_rows = as.dendrogram(batch_hclust),
  cluster_columns = as.dendrogram(batch_hclust),
  bottom_annotation = bottom_annotation,
  show_row_dend = TRUE,
  show_column_dend = TRUE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  column_title = "Honey batch similarity based on shared yeast species",
  row_title = "Batch.ID"
)

draw(
  ht,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right"
)

# Optional save
pdf("Plots/Fig3C_Jaccard_similarity.pdf", width = 13, height = 11)
draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right")
dev.off()


```

```{r Curves}
# Import function
import.gp.curves <- function(path, env, pos) {
  gp <- read.table(path, header = FALSE, sep = "\t") %>% 
    select(-V1) %>% # remove empty first column
    mutate(V2=V2/60) # change time from minutes to hours
  names(gp) <- c("Time", # add column names
                 "A1", "A2", "A3", "A4", "A5", "A6", "A7", "A8", "A9", "A10", "A11", "A12", 
                 "B1", "B2", "B3", "B4", "B5", "B6", "B7", "B8", "B9", "B10", "B11", "B12", 
                 "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "C5", "C6", "C7", "C8", "C9", "C10", "C11", "C12", 
                 "D1", "D2", "D3", "D4", "D5", "D6", "D7", "D8", "D9", "D10", "D11", "D12", 
                 "E1", "E2", "E3", "E4", "E5", "E6", "E7", "E8", "E9", "E10", "E11", "E12", 
                 "F1", "F2", "F3", "F4", "F5", "F6", "F7", "F8", "F9", "F10", "F11", "F12", 
                 "G1", "G2", "G3", "G4", "G5", "G6", "G7", "G8", "G9", "G10", "G11", "G12", 
                 "H1", "H2", "H3", "H4", "H5", "H6", "H7", "H8", "H9", "H10", "H11", "H12")
  # import metadata
  df.names <- read.table("DATA/GrowthProfiler/Metadata_Growthprofiler_CC.tsv", 
                       header = TRUE, sep = "\t") # position H6-H12 are empty media controls.
  # import the full species table
  df.species <- read.table("DATA/Species_blast.tsv",
                       header = TRUE, sep = "\t") 
  df <- df.names %>% 
    left_join(., df.species, by="Strain.ID") %>% 
    select(Position, Strain.ID, Species)
  
  gp.melt <- gp %>% 
  pivot_longer(
      cols = -Time,              # everything except "Time"
      names_to = "Position",
      values_to = "Green.value"
    ) %>%
  left_join(., df, by="Position") %>%
    mutate(Environment=env,
           GP.position=pos ) %>% 
  group_by(Strain.ID)
  return(gp.melt)
}
```

### Growth curver - extract growth phenotypes
```{r}

# Load necessary packages
library(growthcurver)  # For growth curve fitting
library(data.table)    # For efficient data manipulation
library(dplyr)         # For summarization

# Convert your dataset to a data.table (if not already)
df <- as.data.table(gp)

# Helper function to return a data.table with NA values for all traits
na_result <- function(df) {
  data.table(
    Species    = df$Species[1],
    Strain.ID  = df$Strain.ID[1],
    sample     = df$Environment[1],
    k          = NA_real_,
    n0         = NA_real_,
    r          = NA_real_,
    t_mid      = NA_real_,
    t_gen      = NA_real_,
    auc_l      = NA_real_,
    auc_e      = NA_real_,
    sigma      = NA_real_,
    lag_phase  = NA_real_
  )
}

run_growth_curve <- function(df, smooth = TRUE, span = 0.2, flat_threshold = 12, return_curve = FALSE) {
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0 || all(is.na(df$Green.value))) {
    return(na_result(df))
  }
  
  if ((max(df$Green.value, na.rm = TRUE) - min(df$Green.value, na.rm = TRUE)) < flat_threshold) {
    warning("Flat curve detected; skipping growth curve extraction.")
    return(na_result(df))
  }
  
  # Smooth the data
  raw_values <- if (smooth) {
    tryCatch(
      predict(loess(Green.value ~ Time, data = df, span = span)),
      error = function(e) {
        warning("Smoothing failed: ", e$message)
        df$Green.value
      }
    )
  } else {
    df$Green.value
  }
  
  # Make monotonic
  mono_values <- cummax(raw_values)
  
  # Fit growth curve
  fit <- tryCatch(
    SummarizeGrowth(df$Time, mono_values),
    error = function(e) {
      warning("Growth curve fit failed: ", e$message)
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  # Return time-series table if requested
  if (return_curve && !is.null(fit)) {
    fitted_values <- tryCatch(
      predict(fit$model, list(t = df$Time)),
      error = function(e) {
        warning("Fitted values prediction failed: ", e$message)
        rep(NA_real_, length(df$Time))
      }
    )
    
    return(data.table(
      Species     = df$Species[1],
      Strain.ID   = df$Strain.ID[1],
      sample      = df$Environment[1],
      Time        = df$Time,
      Green.value = df$Green.value,
      Smoothed    = raw_values,
      Monotonic   = mono_values,
      Fitted      = fitted_values
    ))
  }
  
  if (is.null(fit)) return(na_result(df))
  
  vals <- fit$vals
  lag_phase <- if (vals$r != 0) vals$t_mid - (1 / vals$r) else NA_real_
  
  # Sanity checks
  if (is.na(lag_phase) || lag_phase < 0 ||
      is.na(vals$k) || vals$k < 0.01 || vals$k > 500 ||
      is.na(vals$n0) || vals$n0 < 0 ||
      is.na(vals$r) || vals$r < 0 || vals$r > 10 ||
      is.na(vals$t_gen) || vals$t_gen <= 0) {
    warning("Abnormal growth curve parameters detected; skipping.")
    return(na_result(df))
  }
  
  # Return traits
  data.table(
    Species    = df$Species[1],
    Strain.ID  = df$Strain.ID[1],
    sample     = df$Environment[1],
    k          = vals$k,
    n0         = vals$n0,
    r          = vals$r,
    t_mid      = vals$t_mid,
    t_gen      = vals$t_gen,
    auc_l      = vals$auc_l,
    auc_e      = vals$auc_e,
    sigma      = vals$sigma,
    lag_phase  = lag_phase
  )
}

# Run across all curves
df.traits <- df[, run_growth_curve(.SD), 
                by = .(Species, Strain.ID, Environment, Position, GP.position)]


# write.table(df.traits, "traits.tsv", quote = F, row.names = F, sep = "\t")

# Summarize traits
df.traits.mean <- df.traits %>% 
  select(-Position, -GP.position) %>%  # Remove grouping variables not needed in summary
  group_by(Species, Strain.ID, Environment) %>%   
  summarise_all(list(
    mean   = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
    median = ~median(., na.rm = TRUE),
    sd     = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE),
    se     = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(.)))
  ))

# write.table(df.traits.mean, "traits_mean.tsv", quote = F, row.names = F, sep = "\t")
```

```{r}
# 1) Create matrix

    auc_e_mean = as.numeric(auc_e_mean)
  ) %>%
  select(Strain, Species, Strain.ID, Environment, auc_e_mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Environment, values_from = auc_e_mean) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(wide_auc) <- wide_auc$Strain

mat_auc <- wide_auc %>%
  select(-Strain, -Species, -Strain.ID) %>%
  as.matrix()

storage.mode(mat_auc) <- "numeric"


# Replace NA with 0
mat_auc[is.na(mat_auc)] <- 0

# rearrange order of environments 

env_order <- c(
  "Fructose, 2%",
  "Glucose, 2%",
  "Glucose, 10%",
  "Glucose, 20%",
  "Glucose, 40%",
  "Glucose, 60%",
  "Glucose, 70%",
  "Glucose, 80%"
)

mat_auc <- mat_auc[, env_order]

colnames(mat_auc) <- c(
  "Fructose 2%",
  "Glucose 2%",
  "Glucose 10%",
  "Glucose 20%",
  "Glucose 40%",
  "Glucose 60%",
  "Glucose 70%",
  "Glucose 80%"
)

# 2) Build metadata
# Here "Family" is intentionally used as your genus-level grouping variable
strain_meta <- df.traits.mean %>%
  filter(!Strain.ID %in% c(950, 865, 1395, 1665, 880, 687, 462, 2272)) %>%
  distinct(Species, Strain.ID) %>%
  separate(
    Species,
    into = c("Family", "name"),
    sep = "^\\S*\\K\\s+",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(Strain = paste(Species, Strain.ID, sep = " "))

# 3) Match metadata order to matrix rows
strain_meta <- strain_meta[match(rownames(mat_auc), strain_meta$Strain), ]
stopifnot(!any(is.na(strain_meta$Strain)))

# 4) Keep only groups present in the palette; everything else becomes "other" via NA
strain_meta <- strain_meta %>%
  mutate(Family = if_else(Family %in% names(fam_cols), Family, NA_character_))

# Optional check: should return character(0)
print(setdiff(unique(na.omit(strain_meta$Family)), names(fam_cols)))

# 5) Row annotation
ha_family <- rowAnnotation(
  Family = strain_meta$Family,
  col = list(Family = fam_cols),
  na_col = "steelblue4"
)

# 6) Heatmap colors
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(
    min(mat_auc, na.rm = TRUE),
    median(mat_auc, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(mat_auc, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  c("white", "#6baed6", "#08306b")
)

# 7) Draw heatmap
pdf("PLOTS/Fig4B_Traits_heatmap.pdf", width = 5, height = 7)

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat_auc,
  name = "auc_e",
  col = col_fun,
  na_col = "gray85",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  left_annotation = ha_family
)

draw(ht)

dev.off()

```

### Fig 4D Species abundance vs glucose tolerance
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Load family colour palette
fam_cols <- readRDS("family_palette_14_spectral_alpha.rds")

df.abundance <- df.species %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Species),
    Species != "No significant",
    Species != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(Strain.ID, Species) %>%
  count(Species, name = "Abundance")

species_palette_tbl <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(Species),
         Species != "No significant",
         Species != "") %>%
  distinct(Species) %>%
  separate(
    Species,
    into = c("Family", "name"),
    sep = "^\\S*\\K\\s+",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Color = fam_cols[Family],
    Color = if_else(is.na(Color), "steelblue4", Color)
  )

species_cols <- setNames(
  species_palette_tbl$Color,
  species_palette_tbl$Species
)

plot_data <- df.traits.mean %>%
  left_join(df.abundance, by = "Species") %>%
  filter(Environment == "Glucose, 70%") %>%
  mutate(
    auc_e_mean = replace(
      auc_e_mean,
      !is.finite(auc_e_mean),
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(
    auc_e_mean = mean(auc_e_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    Abundance = first(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(log_abund = log10(Abundance))


fit <- lm(log_abund ~ auc_e_mean, data = plot_data)

r2 <- summary(fit)$r.squared

r2_label <- paste0(
  "R\u00B2 = ",
  formatC(r2, digits = 2, format = "f")
)

ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(
    x = auc_e_mean,
    y = log_abund,
    color = Species
  )
) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = species_cols) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf,
    y = Inf,
    label = r2_label,
    hjust = 1.1,
    vjust = 1.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Area under curve (70% glucose)",
    y = "Species abundance (log10)"
  ) +
  theme_karl +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave(
  "PLOTS/Fig4D_species_vs_tolerance.pdf",
  width = 5,
  height = 5
)
```

# Sugar consumption and growth

#### Import HPLC data
```{r}

hplc <- read.delim("DATA/HPLC/250512_HPLC_YPDF_HoneyCC.tsv", header = TRUE, fill = TRUE, 
                   na.strings = "N/A") %>% 
  mutate(Strain.ID = as.integer(Strain.ID)) %>% # required to do the join
  left_join(df.species %>% select(Strain.ID, Species), # select only columns needed
            by="Strain.ID") %>%  # join with the species ID loaded earlier in the script
  mutate(Glucose = as.numeric(Glucose)*10, 
         Fructose = as.numeric(Fructose)*10,
         Ethanol = as.numeric(Ethanol)*10) %>% 
  mutate(Sugar.ratio = Glucose/Fructose)

# hplc.controls <- hplc %>% 
#   filter(Media=="YPDF, 10% + 10%") %>% 
#   filter(is.na(Strain.ID)) %>% 
#   summarise_all(list(mean = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
#                      median = ~median(., na.rm = TRUE),
#                      sd = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE),
#                      se = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(sum(!is.na(.)))
#   ))

hplc.2 <- hplc %>% 
  filter(Media=="YPDF, 2+2%") %>% 
  mutate( # calculate the percent reductions - values are the blank medias after some evaporation.
    Glucose_pct_reduction = pmax(0, 100 * (22.23065 - Glucose) / 22.23065),
    Fructose_pct_reduction = pmax(0, 100 * (24.1858 - Fructose) / 24.1858)
  )

hplc.10 <-  hplc %>% 
  filter(Media=="YPDF, 10+10%") %>% 
  mutate( # calculate the percent reductions - values are the blank medias after some evaporation.
    Glucose_pct_reduction = pmax(0, 100 * (113.977 - Glucose) / 113.977),
    Fructose_pct_reduction = pmax(0, 100 * (125.356 - Fructose) / 125.356)
  )
```

### Import Growth Profiler data Glucose vs Fructose

```{r}

# Import function
import.gp.curves <- function(path, env, pos) {
  gp <- read.table(path, header = FALSE, sep = "\t") %>% 
    select(-V1) %>% # remove empty first column
    mutate(V2=V2/60) # change time from minutes to hours
  names(gp) <- c("Time", # add column names
                 "A1", "A2", "A3", "A4", "A5", "A6", "A7", "A8", "A9", "A10", "A11", "A12", 
                 "B1", "B2", "B3", "B4", "B5", "B6", "B7", "B8", "B9", "B10", "B11", "B12", 
                 "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "C5", "C6", "C7", "C8", "C9", "C10", "C11", "C12", 
                 "D1", "D2", "D3", "D4", "D5", "D6", "D7", "D8", "D9", "D10", "D11", "D12", 
                 "E1", "E2", "E3", "E4", "E5", "E6", "E7", "E8", "E9", "E10", "E11", "E12", 
                 "F1", "F2", "F3", "F4", "F5", "F6", "F7", "F8", "F9", "F10", "F11", "F12", 
                 "G1", "G2", "G3", "G4", "G5", "G6", "G7", "G8", "G9", "G10", "G11", "G12", 
                 "H1", "H2", "H3", "H4", "H5", "H6", "H7", "H8", "H9", "H10", "H11", "H12")
  # import metadata
  df.names <- read.table("DATA/GrowthProfiler/Metadata_Growthprofiler_CC.tsv", 
                       header = TRUE, sep = "\t") # position H6-H12 are empty media controls.
  # import the full species table
  df.species <- read.table("DATA/Species_blast.tsv",
                       header = TRUE, sep = "\t") 
  df <- df.names %>% 
    left_join(., df.species, by="Strain.ID") %>% 
    select(Position, Strain.ID, Species)
  
  gp.melt <- gp %>% 
  pivot_longer(
      cols = -Time,              # everything except "Time"
      names_to = "Position",
      values_to = "Green.value"
    ) %>%
  left_join(., df, by="Position") %>%
    mutate(Environment=env,
           GP.position=pos ) %>% 
  group_by(Strain.ID)
  return(gp.melt)
}

# Import growth profiler data
gp2 <- import.gp.curves("DATA/GrowthProfiler/250416_GP1_HoneyCC_YPDF2-2.txt", "YPDF, 2% 2%", 1)
gp3 <- import.gp.curves("DATA/GrowthProfiler/250416_GP2_HoneyCC_YPDF2-2.txt", "YPDF, 2% 2%", 2)
gp4 <- import.gp.curves("DATA/GrowthProfiler/250416_GP3_HoneyCC_YPDF2-2.txt", "YPDF, 2% 2%", 3)
gp6 <- import.gp.curves("DATA/GrowthProfiler/250416_GP4_HoneyCC_YPDF10-10.txt", "YPDF, 10% 10%", 4)
gp7 <- import.gp.curves("DATA/GrowthProfiler/250416_GP5_HoneyCC_YPDF10-10.txt", "YPDF, 10% 10%", 5)
gp8 <- import.gp.curves("DATA/GrowthProfiler/250416_GP6_HoneyCC_YPDF10-10.txt", "YPDF, 10% 10%", 6)

# combine all df:s
gp <- do.call("rbind", list(gp2, gp3, gp4, gp6, gp7, gp8)) %>% 
  filter(!Position %in% c("H6", "H7", "H8", "H9", "H10", "H11", "H12")) # remove empty positions

gp <- do.call("rbind", list(gp4, gp8)) %>% 
  filter(!Position %in% c("H6", "H7", "H8", "H9", "H10", "H11", "H12")) # remove empty positions


# remove temp df:s
rm(gp2, gp3, gp4, gp6, gp7, gp8)


# Caluculate mean values
gp.mean <- gp %>% 
  select(-Position, -GP.position) %>% # remove position
  group_by(Species, Strain.ID, Time, Environment) %>%   
  summarise_all(list(mean = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
                     median = ~median(., na.rm = TRUE),
                     sd = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE),
                     se = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(sum(!is.na(.)))
                     ))
```

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(ggnewscale)

# Add time-zero measurements to HPLC data
start_points_2 <- hplc.2 %>%
  group_by(Strain.ID) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Sample.timepoint.hours = 0,
    Glucose_pct_reduction = 0,
    Fructose_pct_reduction = 0
  )

start_points_10 <- hplc.10 %>%
  group_by(Strain.ID) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Sample.timepoint.hours = 0,
    Glucose_pct_reduction = 0,
    Fructose_pct_reduction = 0
  )

hplc.2_augmented <- bind_rows(hplc.2, start_points_2) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Strain.ID))

hplc.10_augmented <- bind_rows(hplc.10, start_points_10) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Strain.ID))


# HPLC data: convert % reduction to % remaining
hplc_plot_data <- bind_rows(
  hplc.2_augmented %>% 
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(Glucose_pct_reduction, Fructose_pct_reduction),
      names_to = "Sugar",
      values_to = "Reduction"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      group_label = if_else(
        Sugar == "Glucose_pct_reduction",
        "Glucose (2%)",
        "Fructose (2%)"
      )
    ),
  
  hplc.10_augmented %>% 
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(Glucose_pct_reduction, Fructose_pct_reduction),
      names_to = "Sugar",
      values_to = "Reduction"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      group_label = if_else(
        Sugar == "Glucose_pct_reduction",
        "Glucose (10%)",
        "Fructose (10%)"
      )
    )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Remaining = 100 - Reduction
  )

# Growth data: classify runs as 2% or 10%
gp_plot_data <- gp %>% 
  filter(Strain.ID != "Blank") %>% 
  mutate(
    Strain.ID2 = paste("HONEY", Strain.ID, "rep", Position, Environment, GP.position, sep = ""),
    conc_group = case_when(
      str_detect(Environment, "10%") ~ "10%",
      str_detect(Environment, "2%")  ~ "2%",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

ggplot() + 
  # HPLC sugar trajectories
  geom_line(
    data = hplc_plot_data,
    aes(
      x = Sample.timepoint.hours,
      y = Remaining,
      color = group_label,
      group = interaction(Strain.ID, group_label)
    ),
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = hplc_plot_data,
    aes(
      x = Sample.timepoint.hours,
      y = Remaining,
      color = group_label,
      shape = group_label,
      group = interaction(Strain.ID, group_label)
    ),
    size = 1.8
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Glucose (2%)"   = "#4e79a7",
      "Fructose (2%)"  = "#c23b3b",
      "Glucose (10%)"  = "#2c3e50",
      "Fructose (10%)" = "#7a1e1e"
    ),
    name = "Sugar & concentration"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Glucose (2%)"   = 16,
      "Fructose (2%)"  = 16,
      "Glucose (10%)"  = 17,
      "Fructose (10%)" = 17
    ),
    name = "Sugar & concentration"
  ) +

  ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +

  # Growth curves drawn on top
  geom_line(
    data = gp_plot_data,
    aes(
      x = Time,
      y = Green.value,
      group = Strain.ID2,
      color = conc_group
    ),
    alpha = 0.8,
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "2%" = "#9CC4C4",
      "10%" = "#3C7A7A",
      # "2%" = "#7FCDBB", # other color options
      # "10%" = "#1D7874",
      "Other" = "gray70"
    ),
    name = "Growth medium"
  ) +

  xlab("Time (hours)") +
  ylab("Green values / % sugar remaining") +
  facet_wrap(
    ~paste(Species, " (", Strain.ID, ")", sep = ""),
    labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 20)
  ) +

    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold.italic", size = 7),

    axis.line = element_line(colour = "gray15", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "gray15", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(.15, "cm"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(face = "italic", size = 8)
  )
```

```{r}
        "Glucose (10%)",
        "Fructose (10%)"
      )
    )
) %>%
  mutate(Remaining = 100 - Reduction)

# Growth data: classify runs as 2% or 10%
gp_plot_data <- gp %>% 
  filter(
    Strain.ID != "Blank",
    Strain.ID %in% strain_selection
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Strain.ID2 = paste("HONEY", Strain.ID, "rep", Position, Environment, GP.position, sep = ""),
    conc_group = case_when(
      str_detect(Environment, "10%") ~ "10%",
      str_detect(Environment, "2%")  ~ "2%",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

ggplot() + 
  # HPLC sugar trajectories
  geom_line(
    data = hplc_plot_data,
    aes(
      x = Sample.timepoint.hours,
      y = Remaining,
      color = group_label,
      group = interaction(Strain.ID, group_label)
    ),
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = hplc_plot_data,
    aes(
      x = Sample.timepoint.hours,
      y = Remaining,
      color = group_label,
      shape = group_label,
      group = interaction(Strain.ID, group_label)
    ),
    size = 1.8
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Glucose (2%)"   = "#4e79a7",
      "Fructose (2%)"  = "#c23b3b",
      "Glucose (10%)"  = "#2c3e50",
      "Fructose (10%)" = "#7a1e1e"
    ),
    name = "Sugar & concentration"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Glucose (2%)"   = 16,
      "Fructose (2%)"  = 16,
      "Glucose (10%)"  = 17,
      "Fructose (10%)" = 17
    ),
    name = "Sugar & concentration"
  ) +

  ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +

  # Growth curves drawn on top
  geom_line(
    data = gp_plot_data,
    aes(
      x = Time,
      y = Green.value,
      group = Strain.ID2,
      color = conc_group
    ),
    alpha = 0.8,
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "2%" = "#9CC4C4",
      "10%" = "#3C7A7A",
      # "2%" = "#7FCDBB", # other color options
      # "10%" = "#1D7874",
      "Other" = "gray70"
    ),
    name = "Growth medium"
  ) +

  xlab("Time (hours)") +
  ylab("Green values / % sugar remaining") +
  facet_wrap(
    ~paste(Species, " (", Strain.ID, ")", sep = ""),
    labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 20)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 144, by = 12)) +
  theme_karl +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 24),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold.italic", size = 7),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "gray15", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "gray15", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(.15, "cm"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(face = "italic", size = 8)
  )

ggsave("PLOTS/Fig5A_timeresolved_growth_&_sugarlevels.pdf", width = 8, height = 5)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(viridis)

data <- read.delim(
  "DATA/HoneyVocsOAVCalculation.txt",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Log transform quantity
data <- data %>%
  mutate(logQuantity = log10(Quantity_uLng + 1))

heat_data <- data %>%
  group_by(VOC, Sample) %>%
  summarise(
    logQuantity = mean(logQuantity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Sample,
    values_from = logQuantity,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(heat_data) <- heat_data$VOC
heat_data$VOC <- NULL

heat_matrix <- as.matrix(heat_data)

# Match sample order used in radar plots
sample_order <- c(
  "Control",
  "Metschnikowia anglica",
  "Zygosaccharomyces siamensis",
  "Starmerella magnoliae"
  
)

heat_matrix <- heat_matrix[, sample_order]

# Row-wise Z-score scaling
heat_matrix_scaled <- t(scale(t(heat_matrix)))

# Colour scale
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-2, 0, 2),
  c("#2C7F7B", "white", "#C58B39")
)

pdf(
  "PLOTS/Fig6_VOC_heatmap.pdf",
  width = 6,
  height = 8
)

draw(

    cluster_columns = FALSE,

    row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10),
    show_column_names = TRUE,
    column_names_rot = 45,
    row_title = "VOCs"
  )
)
```

### Fig 6E OAV radar plots
```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(fmsb)

# Read data
data <- read.table(
  "DATA/HoneyVocsOAVCalculation.txt",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


agg_data <- data %>%
  group_by(Sample, Aroma) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_OAV = sum(OAV, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_logOAV = log10(Total_OAV)
  )

wide_df <- agg_data %>%
  select(Sample, Aroma, Total_logOAV) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Aroma,
    values_from = Total_logOAV,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Store sample names as row names
sample_names <- wide_df$Sample
wide_df$Sample <- NULL

# Ensure all aroma columns are numeric
wide_df[] <- lapply(
  wide_df,
  function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x))
)

rownames(wide_df) <- sample_names

# Sort aroma categories alphabetically
wide_df <- wide_df[, sort(colnames(wide_df))]


# Same maximum for all panels so the plots are directly comparable
max_val <- max(wide_df, na.rm = TRUE)


sample_colors <- c(
  "Metschnikowia anglica" = "#F8B74C",
  "Zygosaccharomyces siamensis" = "#009EB6",
  "Starmerella magnoliae" = "#ADEAAD"
)

# Control will be plotted as the common background profile
samples_to_plot <- names(sample_colors)


pdf(
  "PLOTS/Fig6_Aroma_Radar_Plots.pdf",
  width = 12,
  height = 4.5
)

par(
  mfrow = c(1, 3),
  mar = c(2, 2, 3, 2),
  xpd = NA
)

for (sample in samples_to_plot) {

  # Data for one panel:
  # 1 = maximum
  # 2 = minimum
  # 3 = Control
  # 4 = yeast strain
  plot_data <- rbind(
    max = rep(max_val, ncol(wide_df)),
    min = rep(0, ncol(wide_df)),
    Control = wide_df["Control", ],
    Yeast = wide_df[sample, ]
  )

  yeast_col <- sample_colors[sample]

  radarchart(
    plot_data,

    # No numerical axis labels
    axistype = 0,

    # Control first, yeast second
    pcol = c(
      "grey75",
      yeast_col
    ),

    # Transparent fills
    pfcol = c(
      adjustcolor("grey60", alpha.f = 0.20),
      adjustcolor(yeast_col, alpha.f = 0.35)
    ),

    # Line widths
    plwd = c(2, 3),
    
    # Remove the ponts
    pty = NA,

    # Solid lines
    plty = c(1, 1),

    # Grid appearance
    cglcol = "grey85",
    cglty = 1,
    cglwd = 0.8,

    # Hide numerical scale labels
    axislabcol = NA,
    caxislabels = rep("", 5),

    # Aroma-category label size
    vlcex = 1.1,

    # Panel title
    title = sample
  )
}

dev.off()
```

### Fig 6A fermentation
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(colorspace)

# load the data
df.ferm <- read.table("DATA/honey_fermentation_test_60-90.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t") %>% 
  left_join(df.species %>% select(Strain.ID, Species), by = "Strain.ID") %>% 
  # select(-c(Day0)) %>% # Remove day 0
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Day"),
    names_to = "Days",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Days = readr::parse_number(Days))


# Collapse replicates using max (logical OR)
df.any <- df.ferm %>%
  group_by(Strain.ID, Species, Honey.conc, Days) %>%
  summarise(value = max(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(row_id = paste(Strain.ID, Honey.conc, sep = "_")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Days, values_from = value) %>%
  arrange(Honey.conc, Species, Strain.ID)

# Build matrix
mat <- df.any %>%
  select(-row_id, -Strain.ID, -Species, -Honey.conc) %>%
  as.matrix()

rownames(mat) <- df.any$row_id

# Ensure correct day order
mat <- mat[, order(as.numeric(colnames(mat))), drop = FALSE]

# Define annotation color mappings
species_levels <- unique(df.any$Species)
honey_levels <- sort(unique(df.any$Honey.conc))

species_cols <- setNames(
  hcl.colors(length(species_levels), palette = "Fall"),
  species_levels
)

honey_cols <- setNames(
  rev(sequential_hcl(length(honey_levels), palette = "YlOrBr")),
  as.character(honey_levels)
)

# Separate row annotations
left_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  Honey = as.factor(df.any$Honey.conc),
  col = list(
    Honey = honey_cols
  )
)

right_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  Species = df.any$Species,
  col = list(
    Species = species_cols
  )
)

# Heatmap
ht <- Heatmap(
  mat,
  name = "Fermentation detected",
  col = c("0" = "grey95", "1" = "#355C7D"),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  rect_gp = grid::gpar(col = "grey85"),
  row_split = as.factor(df.any$Honey.conc),
  left_annotation = left_ha,
  right_annotation = right_ha,
  column_title = "Days",
  column_names_side = "top",
  column_names_rot = 0,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    at = c(0, 1),
    labels = c("No", "Yes")
  ),
  na_col = "grey95"
)


pdf("PLOTS/Fig6_fermentation.pdf", width = 6, height = 8)

draw(ht)

dev.off()
```

#### Fig6B PCA
```{r}

DATA    <- "DATA/honey_lcms_feature_table.csv"
OUT_DIR <- "."

#analysis settings
MIN_DETECTED <- 3        
                         
SCALING      <- "pareto" 
N_PERM       <- 9999     
SEED         <- 23

GROUPS <- list(
  "Honey (control)"  = c("H1", "H2", "H3"),
  "M. anglica"       = c("7781",  "7782",  "7783"),
  "Z. siamensis"     = c("12021", "12022", "12023"),
  "E. paramagnoliae" = c("11471", "11472", "11473")
)

GCOL <- c("Honey (control)" = "#7F8486", "M. anglica"       = "#E69F00",
          "Z. siamensis"    = "#0072B2", "E. paramagnoliae" = "#009E73")
GPCH <- c("Honey (control)" = 21, "M. anglica" = 24,
          "Z. siamensis"    = 22, "E. paramagnoliae" = 23)

SAMPLES <- unlist(GROUPS, use.names = FALSE)
GLAB    <- rep(names(GROUPS), lengths(GROUPS))

ft <- read.csv(DATA, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
               na.strings = c("NA", ""))
stopifnot(all(SAMPLES %in% names(ft)))
ft <- ft[as.logical(ft$curated) %in% TRUE, ]
message(sprintf("curated features: %d", nrow(ft)))

X <- as.matrix(ft[, SAMPLES]); storage.mode(X) <- "double"
X[!is.finite(X) | X <= 0] <- NA
X <- X[rowSums(!is.na(X)) >= MIN_DETECTED, , drop = FALSE]
n_imp <- sum(is.na(X))
if (n_imp) {                                   # half the feature's own minimum
  fmin <- apply(X, 1, min, na.rm = TRUE)
  X[is.na(X)] <- fmin[row(X)[is.na(X)]] / 2
}
message(sprintf("features entering the PCA: %d (%d imputed cells)", nrow(X), n_imp))

A <- t(log2(X))                                # samples in rows
A <- scale(A, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
if (SCALING != "none") {
  sdv <- apply(A, 2, stats::sd); sdv[sdv == 0 | is.na(sdv)] <- 1
  A <- sweep(A, 2, if (SCALING == "uv") sdv else sqrt(sdv), "/")
}
A[is.na(A)] <- 0




# PCA
pc  <- stats::prcomp(A, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
var <- 100 * pc$sdev^2 / sum(pc$sdev^2)
sc  <- pc$x[, 1:2]
message(sprintf("PC1 %.1f %%   PC2 %.1f %%", var[1], var[2]))
utils::write.csv(data.frame(sample = rownames(sc), group = GLAB,
                            PC1 = sc[, 1], PC2 = sc[, 2]),
                 file.path(OUT_DIR, "Fig6B_PCA_scores.csv"), row.names = FALSE)



# PERMANOVA on Euclidean distances
D <- as.matrix(stats::dist(A))^2
N <- nrow(A); a <- length(GROUPS)
Fstat <- function(g) {
  tot <- sum(D) / (2 * N)
  wit <- sum(vapply(unique(g), function(k) {
    i <- which(g == k); sum(D[i, i]) / (2 * length(i)) }, numeric(1)))
  c(F = ((tot - wit) / (a - 1)) / (wit / (N - a)), R2 = (tot - wit) / tot)
}
obs <- Fstat(GLAB)
set.seed(SEED)
nullF <- replicate(N_PERM, Fstat(sample(GLAB))["F"])
p_man <- (1 + sum(nullF >= obs["F"])) / (N_PERM + 1)
message(sprintf("PERMANOVA  F = %.2f  R2 = %.3f  p = %.4f  (%d permutations)",
                obs["F"], obs["R2"], p_man, N_PERM))




# PERMDISP
g   <- factor(GLAB, levels = names(GROUPS))
cen <- t(sapply(levels(g), function(k) colMeans(A[g == k, , drop = FALSE])))
d2c <- sqrt(rowSums((A - cen[as.character(g), ])^2))
Fd  <- function(y, gr) stats::anova(stats::lm(y ~ gr))[1, "F value"]
f0  <- Fd(d2c, g)
set.seed(SEED)
p_disp <- (1 + sum(replicate(N_PERM, Fd(d2c, sample(g))) >= f0)) / (N_PERM + 1)
message(sprintf("PERMDISP   F = %.2f  p = %.3f  (homogeneous if p > 0.05)", f0, p_disp))

# figure
draw <- function() {
  op <- par(mar = c(4.2, 4.4, 1.0, 1.0), las = 1, cex.axis = .85, cex.lab = .95,
            tcl = -.25, mgp = c(2.6, .6, 0))
  on.exit(par(op))
  r <- function(v) range(v) + c(-1, 1) * diff(range(v)) * .14
  plot(NA, xlim = r(sc[, 1]), ylim = r(sc[, 2]), axes = FALSE,
       xlab = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f %%)", var[1]),
       ylab = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f %%)", var[2]))
  axis(1, lwd = 0, lwd.ticks = 1.4); axis(2, lwd = 0, lwd.ticks = 1.4)
  abline(h = 0, v = 0, col = "#EBEEEE", lwd = 1.1)
  for (k in names(GROUPS)) {                   # convex hull per treatment
    i <- which(GLAB == k); h <- grDevices::chull(sc[i, ])
    polygon(sc[i[h], 1], sc[i[h], 2],
            col = grDevices::adjustcolor(GCOL[k], alpha.f = .15),
            border = GCOL[k], lwd = 1.6)
  }
  points(sc[, 1], sc[, 2], pch = GPCH[GLAB], bg = GCOL[GLAB],
         col = "white", cex = 1.5, lwd = 1.1)
  legend("topleft", legend = names(GROUPS), pch = GPCH[names(GROUPS)],
         pt.bg = GCOL[names(GROUPS)], col = "white", pt.cex = 1.4, pt.lwd = 1.1,
         bty = "n", cex = .8, text.font = c(1, 3, 3, 3), y.intersp = 1.25)
  box(bty = "l", lwd = 1.2)
}


# Open PDF device
pdf("PLOTS/Fig6B_PCA.pdf", width = 5.6, height = 5)

# Draw the plot
draw()

# Close and save the PDF
dev.off()



```


### Fig6C CANOPUS_composition
```{r}

DATA    <- "DATA/honey_lcms_feature_table.csv"
OUT_DIR <- "."

PATHWAY_PROB_MIN <- 0.5

GROUPS <- list(
  "Honey (control)"  = c("H1", "H2", "H3"),
  "M. anglica"       = c("7781",  "7782",  "7783"),
  "Z. siamensis"     = c("12021", "12022", "12023"),
  "E. paramagnoliae" = c("11471", "11472", "11473")
)

PCOL <- c("Amino acids and Peptides"        = "#A05195",
          "Alkaloids"                       = "#56B4E9",
          "Fatty acids"                     = "#D55E00",
          "Carbohydrates"                   = "#5F9E3E",
          "Terpenoids"                      = "#117733",
          "Polyketides"                     = "#CC6677",
          "Shikimates and Phenylpropanoids" = "#DDAA33")
SAMPLES <- unlist(GROUPS, use.names = FALSE)

# data 
ft <- read.csv(DATA, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
               na.strings = c("NA", ""))
stopifnot(all(SAMPLES %in% names(ft)))
ft <- ft[as.logical(ft$curated) %in% TRUE, ]

ann <- ft[!is.na(ft$CANOPUS_pathway) &
          !is.na(ft$CANOPUS_pathway_prob) &
          ft$CANOPUS_pathway_prob > PATHWAY_PROB_MIN, ]
message(sprintf("curated %d | pathway call %d | above p > %.2f: %d (%.0f %% of curated)",
                nrow(ft), sum(!is.na(ft$CANOPUS_pathway)), PATHWAY_PROB_MIN,
                nrow(ann), 100 * nrow(ann) / nrow(ft)))

cat("\n--- superclass composition of each pathway ---\n")
for (p in sort(unique(ann$CANOPUS_pathway))) {
  s <- sort(table(ann$CANOPUS_superclass[ann$CANOPUS_pathway == p]), decreasing = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("\n%s  (n = %d)\n", p, sum(ann$CANOPUS_pathway == p)))
  print(utils::head(s, 5))
}

X <- as.matrix(ann[, SAMPLES]); storage.mode(X) <- "double"
X[!is.finite(X)] <- 0
sh <- rowsum(X, ann$CANOPUS_pathway)                 # pathway x sample
sh <- sweep(sh, 2, colSums(sh), "/") * 100           # per-sample percentages
gm <- sapply(GROUPS, function(cs) rowMeans(sh[, cs, drop = FALSE]))
ord <- rownames(gm)[order(rowMeans(gm), decreasing = TRUE)]
sh  <- sh[ord, , drop = FALSE]; gm <- gm[ord, , drop = FALSE]

cat("\n--- group mean share of annotated signal (%) ---\n"); print(round(gm, 1))
cat("\n--- SD among the three honey control replicates (percentage points) ---\n")
print(round(apply(sh[, GROUPS[["Honey (control)"]], drop = FALSE], 1, stats::sd), 2))
utils::write.csv(data.frame(pathway = ord, round(sh, 3), check.names = FALSE),
                 file.path(OUT_DIR, "Fig6C_pathway_shares.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# figure 
cols_p <- ifelse(ord %in% names(PCOL), PCOL[ord], "#8C8C8C"); names(cols_p) <- ord
draw <- function() {
  graphics::layout(matrix(1:2, 2, 1), heights = c(4.0, 1.25))
  op <- par(mar = c(4.0, 9.2, 1.0, 1.0), las = 1, xpd = NA, cex.axis = .8,
            cex.lab = .9, tcl = -.25, mgp = c(2.5, .55, 0))
  on.exit({ par(op); graphics::layout(1) })

  gr <- rev(names(GROUPS))
  plot(NA, xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(.4, length(gr) + .6), axes = FALSE,
       xlab = "share of annotated signal (%)", ylab = "")
  axis(1, at = seq(0, 100, 20), lwd = 0, lwd.ticks = 1.4)
  par(xpd = FALSE); abline(v = seq(0, 100, 20), col = "#EBEEEE", lwd = 1.1); par(xpd = NA)
  for (k in seq_along(gr)) {
    left <- 0
    for (p in ord) {
      v <- gm[p, gr[k]]
      rect(left, k - .3, left + v, k + .3, col = cols_p[p], border = "white", lwd = 2.0)
      if (v >= 5) text(left + v / 2, k, sprintf("%.0f", v), col = "white",
                       cex = .68, font = 2)
      left <- left + v
    }
    text(-2, k, sub(" \\(control\\)", "", gr[k]), adj = 1, cex = .85,
         font = if (grepl("\\.", gr[k])) 3 else 1)
  }

  par(mar = c(0, 1, 0, 1))
  plot.new(); plot.window(c(0, 1), c(0, 1))
  legend(0.02, 0.95, legend = ord, fill = cols_p[ord], border = "white",
         bty = "n", cex = .72, ncol = 3, x.intersp = .5, y.intersp = 1.25,
         title = "CANOPUS pathway", title.adj = 0, title.cex = .75)
}


# Open PDF device
pdf("PLOTS/Fig6C_CANOPUS.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)

# Draw the plot
draw()

# Close and save the PDF
dev.off()


```
